people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Sinai
people.line: Mountain where Moses received the Ten Commandments

translations.web: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all the commandments that Yahweh had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.
translations.bsb: And after this all the Israelites came near, and Moses commanded them to do everything that the LORD had told him on Mount Sinai.
translations.kjv: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the LORD had spoken with him in mount Sinai.
translations.asv: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that Jehovah had spoken with him in mount Sinai.
